"''They reap what they sow. When the people show loyalty to the Empire, they will be allowed to flourish. But not before.|Barriss Offee and the Fourth Sister|}} A '''settlement''' was located on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky planet]]. After the [[Great Jedi Purge|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order]] and rise of the [[Galactic Empire]], the Imperial [[Inquisitorius]] [[Mission to a rocky planet|dispatched]] the [[Fourth Sister]] and [[Barriss Offee]] to the planet in search of a [[Unidentified human Jedi|hiding Jedi]] who was working with the [[planet]]'s local [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]]. As the two [[Inquisitor|Inquisitors]] interrogated the population, the settlement's [[Unidentified human governor|governor]] claimed there were no [[Jedi]] on the world. However, when Offee discovered the Jedi was hiding in the mountains, the Fourth Sister [[Death|massacred]] the [[governor]] and the gathered citizens in retaliation before the pair went into the mountains to hunt the Jedi. {{Loc-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TOTE|Realization}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Settlements]]
